players.name: Baker Mayfield
wk: Baker Reagan Mayfield is an American professional football quarterback for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He began his college football career with the Texas Tech Red Raiders before transferring to the Oklahoma Sooners. In 2017, he became the first Heisman Trophy winner since the introduction of athletic scholarships in the 1950s to have begun his college career as a walk-on. The Cleveland Browns selected him first overall in the 2018 NFL draft.

players.name: Cade Otton
wk: Cade Otton is an American professional football tight end for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He previously played college football for the Washington Huskies before being selected by the Buccaneers in the fourth round of the 2022 NFL draft.

players.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
wk: Rod Christopher Godwin Jr. is an American professional football wide receiver for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Penn State Nittany Lions and was selected by the Buccaneers in the third round of the 2017 NFL draft. He won a Super Bowl championship with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in their victory over the Kansas City Chiefs in Super Bowl LV.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
wk: Emeka Egbuka is an American professional football wide receiver for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Ohio State Buckeyes, finishing as their career receptions leader prior to being selected by the Buccaneers in the first round of the 2025 NFL draft.

players.name: Cooper Rush
wk: Cooper Robert Rush is an American professional football quarterback for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Central Michigan Chippewas, and was signed by the Dallas Cowboys as an undrafted free agent in 2017.

players.name: Bucky Irving
wk: Mar'Keise "Bucky" Irving is an American professional football running back for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Minnesota Golden Gophers and Oregon Ducks.

players.name: Jalon Daniels
wk: Jalon Daniels is an American professional football quarterback for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Kansas Jayhawks and earned second-team All-Big 12 honors in 2022.

players.name: Tez Johnson
wk: Keyonteze "Tez" Johnson is an American professional wide receiver for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Troy Trojans and Oregon Ducks. Johnson was selected by the Buccaneers in the seventh round of the 2025 NFL draft.

players.name: Kenny Gainwell
wk: Kenneth "Kenny" Gainwell is an American professional football running back and kick returner for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Memphis Tigers.

players.name: Payne Durham
wk: William Payne Durham is an American professional football tight end for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Purdue Boilermakers.

players.name: David Sills
wk: David Sills V is an American professional football wide receiver.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
wk: Jalen McMillan is an American professional football wide receiver for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Washington Huskies and was selected by the Buccaneers in the third round of the 2024 NFL draft.

players.name: Sean Tucker
wk: Sean Lance Tucker is an American professional football running back and kickoff returner for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Syracuse Orange and was signed as an undrafted free agent by the Buccaneers after the 2023 NFL draft.

players.name: Kameron Johnson
wk: Kameron Johnson is an American professional football wide receiver and return specialist for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Barton Bulldogs.

players.name: Ko Kieft
wk: Ko Jason Kieft is an American professional football tight end for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Minnesota Golden Gophers.
